items.title: Spider Descending on Silk
items.alt: A friendly charcoal spider descends beneath one curved twig on a single silk thread, eight legs spread clearly with four on each side.
items.description: A friendly charcoal spider descends beneath one curved twig on a single silk thread, eight legs spread clearly with four on each side. Useful for movement vocabulary.

items.title: Brown Spider from Above
items.alt: A warm brown spider viewed from above with eight clearly separated jointed legs spread in four pairs.
items.description: A warm brown spider viewed from above with eight clearly separated jointed legs spread in four pairs. Useful for counting activities and nature vocabulary.

items.title: Spider Building a Corner Web
items.alt: One plum-gray spider sits beside a compact triangular corner web and reaches one of its eight legs toward the unfinished outer thread.
items.description: One plum-gray spider sits beside a compact triangular corner web and reaches one of its eight legs toward the unfinished outer thread. Useful for sequence activities.
